entries.title: Genesis 31:1
segments: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that [was] our father's, and he has gotten all this glory from that which was our father's.

entries.title: Genesis 31:2
segments: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

entries.title: Genesis 31:3
segments: And the LORD said to Jacob, Return to the land of your fathers, and to your kindred, and I will be with you.

entries.title: Genesis 31:4
segments: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flocks.

entries.title: Genesis 31:5
segments: And he said to them, I see your father's face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:6
segments: And you know that with all my power I have served your father,

entries.title: Genesis 31:7
segments: and your father has deceived me and changed my wages ten times. But God did not allow him to hurt me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:8
segments: If he said this, The speckled shall be your wages, then all the flocks bore speckled. And if he said this, The striped shall be your hire, then all the flocks bore striped.

entries.title: Genesis 31:9
segments: And God has taken away the flocks of your father, and has given them to me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:10
segments: And at the time the cattle conceived, I lifted up my eyes and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were striped, speckled, and mottled.

entries.title: Genesis 31:11
segments: And the Angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, Jacob! And I said, Here I [am].

entries.title: Genesis 31:12
segments: And He said, Lift up your eyes and see all the rams which leap upon the cattle, that they [are] striped, speckled, and mottled. For I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.

entries.title: Genesis 31:13
segments: I [am] the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar, where you vowed a vow to Me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your kindred.

entries.title: Genesis 31:14
segments: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, [Is there] yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

entries.title: Genesis 31:15
segments: Are we not counted strangers by him? For he has sold us, and has also entirely devoured our silver.

entries.title: Genesis 31:16
segments: For all the riches which God has taken from our father, that [is] for us and for our sons. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.

entries.title: Genesis 31:17
segments: Then Jacob rose up and set his sons and wives upon camels.

entries.title: Genesis 31:18
segments: And he drove away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his property, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, in order to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 31:19
segments: And Laban went to shear his sheep. And Rachel had stolen the images which were her father's.

entries.title: Genesis 31:20
segments: And Jacob deceived the heart of Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he fled.

entries.title: Genesis 31:21
segments: And he fled with all that was his. And he rose up and passed over the river, and set his face toward Mount Gilead.

entries.title: Genesis 31:22
segments: It was told Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled.

entries.title: Genesis 31:23
segments: And he took his brothers with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey. And they overtook him in Mount Gilead.

entries.title: Genesis 31:24
segments: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, Take heed that you do not speak either good or bad to Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 31:25
segments: Then Laban overtook Jacob. And Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount. And Laban with his brothers pitched in Mount Gilead.

entries.title: Genesis 31:26
segments: And Laban said to Jacob, What have you done, that you have deceived my heart and carried away my daughters as captives [taken] with the sword?

entries.title: Genesis 31:27
segments: Why did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me, and did not tell me so that I might have sent you away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret and with harp?

entries.title: Genesis 31:28
segments: And why have you not allowed me to kiss my sons and my daughters? You have done foolishly in so doing.

entries.title: Genesis 31:29
segments: It is in the power of my hand to do you harm. But the God of your fathers spoke to me last night, saying, Take heed that you do not speak either good or bad to Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 31:30
segments: And now you have gone because you longed after your father's house. Why have you stolen my gods?

entries.title: Genesis 31:31
segments: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I [was] afraid, for I said, Perhaps you would take your daughters away from me by force.

entries.title: Genesis 31:32
segments: With whomever you find your gods, let him not live. Before our brothers, choose what [is] yours with me, and take [it] to you. For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.

entries.title: Genesis 31:33
segments: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the tents of the two slave women, and he did not find. And he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

entries.title: Genesis 31:34
segments: And Rachel had taken the images and put them into the camel's saddle, and sat on them. And Laban searched all the tent, but did not find them.

entries.title: Genesis 31:35
segments: But she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before you. For the custom of women [is] upon me. And he searched, but did not find the images.

entries.title: Genesis 31:36
segments: And Jacob was angry, and rebuked Laban. And Jacob answered and said to Laban, What [is] my trespass? What [is] my sin, that you have so hotly pursued after me?

entries.title: Genesis 31:37
segments: For you have searched all my stuff; what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my brothers and your brothers, that they may judge between us both.

entries.title: Genesis 31:38
segments: I [was] with you these twenty years. Your ewes and she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of your flock I have not eaten.

entries.title: Genesis 31:39
segments: That which was mangled I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it. You required it at my hand, [whether] stolen by day, or stolen by night.

entries.title: Genesis 31:40
segments: I was there; in the day the heat consumed me, and the frost by night. And my sleep departed from my eyes.

entries.title: Genesis 31:41
segments: And I have been twenty years in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six for your flocks. And you have changed my wages ten times.

entries.title: Genesis 31:42
segments: Unless the God of my fathers, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac had been with me, surely you would have sent me away now empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked [you last] night.

entries.title: Genesis 31:43
segments: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, The daughters [are] my daughters, and the sons my sons, and the flocks my flocks. All that you see [is] mine. And what can I do this day to these my daughters, or to their sons which they have borne?

entries.title: Genesis 31:44
segments: And come now, let us make a covenant, you and I. And let it be for a witness between you and me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:45
segments: And Jacob took a stone and set it up as a memorial pillar.

entries.title: Genesis 31:46
segments: And Jacob said to his brothers, Gather stones. And they took stones and made a heap. And they ate there upon the heap.

entries.title: Genesis 31:47
segments: And Laban called it in [Syrian], Heap of the Testimony, and Jacob called it in Hebrew, Heap of Testimony.

entries.title: Genesis 31:48
segments: And Laban said, This heap [is] a witness between you and me this day. Therefore the name of it was called Heap of Testimony,

entries.title: Genesis 31:49
segments: and Watchtower, for he said, The LORD watch between you and me when we are absent from one another.

entries.title: Genesis 31:50
segments: If you shall afflict my daughters, or if you shall take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us. See! God is witness between you and me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:51
segments: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold the pillar which I have set up between you and me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:52
segments: This heap [is] a witness, and the pillar [is] a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you shall not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

entries.title: Genesis 31:53
segments: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us. And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 31:54
segments: And Jacob offered sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brothers to eat bread. And they ate bread and stayed all night in the mountain.

entries.title: Genesis 31:55
segments: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. And Laban departed and returned to his place.
